'''BD-148''' was an elite [[Skytrooper]], a type of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] used by the [[Eternal Empire]] of [[Zakuul]].<ref name="KOTFE" /> In [[3636 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> it was one of many deployed on [[Darth Marr's flagship]] during a [[Destruction of Darth Marr's flagship|battle]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="KOTFE" /> In the main engineering deck, it was destroyed by the enemy combatant who later became known as [[Alliance Commander|The Commander]], and [[Darth Marr]].<ref name="KOTFE" />

==Behind the scenes==
BD-148 appears as an enemy in Chapter I: The Hunt in [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire|''Knights of the Fallen Empire'']], a [[2015]] Digital Expansion to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="KOTFE" /> BD-148 was originally named Skytrooper ZEM-53EB, as can be seen in the early playthroughs of Chapter I, but the droid's name was changed by the time of final release.
